projects.title: Deception-Probing Dataset Generator & Activation-Space Analysis Pipeline
projects.description: I built a full production-ready pipeline for studying how large language models internally represent honest vs deceptive intent. The project combines dataset generation, structured safety evals, and activation-space probing.What I builtA data-generation system using Anthropic’s Claude 4.5 Sonnet that creates paired honest vs deceptive instructions with consistent factual answers.Two complete 500-example JSONL datasets (Direct and Subtle deception), each covering 25 themes.A reproducible analysis pipeline (RunPod-friendly) that loads a base LLM (e.g. Llama 3.1 8B Instruct), extracts hidden states, and trains non-linear probes to detect deceptive intent from activations.What the pipeline doesGenerates high-quality deception-probing pairs using structured JSON outputs.Runs forward passes through the model with hidden-state extraction (residual stream).Builds pooled or per-token representation features for each example.Trains and evaluates non-linear MLP probes to classify honest vs deceptive intent.Compares intent signals across “Direct” (explicit harm) vs “Subtle” (manipulative, indirect) deception.Performs similarity analysis and representation-space comparisons across layers.Key resultsDirect deception yields very strong, easily separable activation signatures.Subtle deception is more challenging but still detectable significantly above chance.Early assistant-answer tokens already carry clear intent signals, even before the full answer is processed.

projects.title: HireSong
projects.description: This project was for part of what we built with my team for CamHack 2025, where the theme was to use technology in an unintended way. You put your CV, the company website you wanna work for, and a selfie and the app creates a music video of you applying to the company. We used: - React & Vite for the frontend- Python for the backend- OpenAI for lyrics and scenes generation- Nano Banana & Knling 2.5 Pro via Fal for the scene generation- ElevenLabs music API for music- Google sheets as database (unintended use for the track)- MoviePy to put everything together - Vercel for frontend deployment- Railway for backend deployment

projects.title: Modeling Time-Series Data: Fourier, Exponential & Polynomial Regression
projects.description: IB Data Science Coursework: Time-Series Analysis & Regression• Overview: Developed a suite of Python notebooks and hands-on exercises that guide the full modeling lifecycle—from exploratory visualization and simple linear fits to advanced seasonal decomposition and model selection.• Key Analyses:Atmospheric CO₂ Trends: Loaded multi-year CO₂ measurements, detected and modeled trend + seasonality via Fourier terms, and validated on held-out data.Exponential Growth Modeling: Fitted log-linear regressions to U.K. COVID hospital admissions (Dec 2021–Jan 2022) to quantify the Omicron surge’s weekly growth rate.Transit Ridership Seasonality: Investigated London Underground passenger data (2000–2019), used periodograms to pinpoint annual and holiday cycles, and built hybrid trend + Fourier regression models.• Technical Skills: Python, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, spectral analysis (periodograms), Vandermonde matrices, least-squares fitting, residual diagnostics, model evaluation (SSE, MSE, R²), and overfitting prevention.• Impact: Demonstrates best practices in time-series decomposition, model calibration, and selection—equipping users to handle real-world forecasting and pattern-discovery challenges.

projects.title: Fine-tuning-Llama-3.1-8B-with-LoRA-using-GRPO
projects.description: Finetuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using GRPO (same method as DeepSeek) in order to develop reasoning and increase its performance in math problems. Its performance went from 45% to 80% on the gsm8k dataset, which has high school problems!
